'''Morro the Reaper''' was an individual who worked as a merchant aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
